description: Land Title Settlement Department - Atthidiya South, Rathmalana D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521002
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the determination of titles for specific land parcels (Nos. 306, 307, 518, and 197) in Attidiya South. It contains detailed information about land ownership, property boundaries, encumbrances, mortgages, and servitude rights. The content falls under the Registration of Title Act and is published in the "PART III - LANDS" section of the gazette, making it clearly a land-related matter that fits Type 4 classification.
